metaTitle: Custom Rectangular Stick On Magnetic Calendars | Perfect
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular stick on magnetic calendars with your logo. Perfect for desk or fridge. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular stick on magnetic calendars offer a clean, professional look that fits neatly on file cabinets, desks, or fridge doors. Unlike odd-shaped calendars, the rectangular format provides maximum space for monthly grids and your branding. Whether you choose a vertical desk style or a horizontal layout, these calendars keep your company name visible all year. Options like the 2027 Triumph® Econo Desk or Contemporary Press-N-Stick™ Calendar give you proven designs that recipients actually use. Perfect for marketing directors and business owners looking for year-long brand exposure.
heroAltText: Custom rectangular stick on magnetic calendar with monthly grid and company logo on a metal filing cabinet
